title: Artificial Intelligence in Construction: Building a Sustainable Future
description: Artificial intelligence optimizes construction with project planning, safety monitoring, and sustainable design, reducing costs.
short_description: A grounded look at AI in Construction, covering what works, what wobbles, and what matters in practice.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in Construction for developers, site managers, architects, and readers tracking the built environment.
